thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered - metering-aggregator: shadow ledger drift detected. Shadow vs primary token counts +7.2% over last 10m, spike in overage flags. Severity: P2. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/29821 Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/metering-ledger
eng-oncall-lee: on call, ACK. Spinning up triage. Assigning tasks: billing to validate counts, SRE to check consumer lag, support to assess customer visible alerts.
billing-raj: I can reproduce the delta from the shadow aggregator. Quick query: `SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM shadow_agg WHERE hour=now()-1h;` returned 1,323,456 vs primary 1,234,567. Looks like replays/duplication at emitter upstream.
sre-olivia: confirming, kafka consumer group metering-emitter-consumer shows ~12k lag followed by bursts. Command used: `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group metering-emitter-consumer --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092` - offsets indicate repeated reprocessing windows around partition 3. Investigating partition leader flaps.
maria: support has 4 customer tickets so far reporting overage emails (cust IDs: CUST-9981, CUST-2210, CUST-4432, CUST-7100). No charge posted yet, flags only. Support is holding further overage emails until we confirm.
support-emma: pausing automated overage notifications for all accounts affected. Posting status update to status.redwood.com now. (will attach incident link). :white_check_mark:
eng-oncall-lee: short mitigation proposal: enable the "smoothing fallback" on the emitter (de-dup + 5m smoothing window) to cut duplicate spikes and restore counts to primary. Also start a targeted backfill that dedups by event_id for the last 2 hours. billing-raj, can you kick off the backfill job?
billing-raj: starting backfill job: backfill-174333-01, dedupe by event_id, window: 2h, parallelism: 4. ETA ~45m. I'll stream progress to this thread.
eng-oncall-lee: I'll roll canary to enable METERING_USE_SMOOTHING=true on 10% of emitters in eu-prod. Pushing now.
incident-bot: Canary rollout detected: 10% emitter canary enabled at 1743332340. Monitoring metrics.
sre-olivia: after canary, kafka consumer offsets stabilized for the canary group, bursts reduced on partition 3. Looks like emitter-level duplicate flush was causing the replay bursts.
incident-bot: Metric update: shadow-primary delta down to +1.1% over last 10m after canary (was +7.2%). Overage flag spike rate down 78%.
eng-oncall-lee: good signal. Keep smoothing enabled and continue backfill. Next actions: 1) finish backfill and compare reconciled counts, 2) promote canary to 100% if backfill confirms, 3) open RCA board and schedule postmortem. Anyone on customer comms?
support-emma: I've posted an update on status page and replied to the 4 tickets noting we're investigating and have paused alerts; will prepare a post-incident customer note.
pm-ops: customer exposure summary requested: which customers saw flags vs actual billing risk? maria?
maria: flags only, no charges applied yet. Cust-4432 and Cust-7100 reported UI overage banners; both are on alerting-only thresholds. Recommend message: apology + confirmation no charges applied + timeline for fix.
eng-oncall-lee: agree. I'll keep this thread updated. Action items recorded: SRE to add replay threshold alert (consumer lag bursts >5k in 5m) and circuit breaker on emitter duplicates; Billing to add a reconciliation job to run hourly and alert if shadow-primary >2% for 15m; Support to prepare customer comms.
billing-raj: backfill progress: 25% complete, duplicate events trimmed ~9k, reconciled delta trending toward 0.8%. Will post final report when done.
incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P3 at 1743332525 based on reduced customer impact and reconciliation progress.
eng-oncall-lee: thanks all. Keep monitoring for another hour, then we'll confirm canary promotion. Postmortem and follow-ups to be scheduled tomorrow. :thumbsup:
